title: Bump Vite 8.3.1 → 8.3.4 in console-lab
summary: A dependency-only change: apps/console-lab pins Vite to 8.3.4 instead of 8.3.1, and pnpm-lock.yaml is regenerated to match. The bump drags the Vite toolchain forward with it — rolldown 1.2.11 → 1.2.14 (and all fifteen of its platform bindings), @oxc-project/types 0.151.0 → 0.154.0, postcss 8.5.28 → 8.5.30, nanoid 3.3.19 → 3.3.20, and a new source-map-js 1.2.2 snapshot. No application source, config or build script changed; the console-lab dev server and single-file bundle are produced by the same plugins, just on newer internals.
